text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementHealthYou May be Able to Get 43 More Minutes of Work Done if You Change Your DeskIt’s time for workers to stand up JCBy Jake Currie4:00 PM CST on November 12, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleHave you ever wished you had an extra hour in the day? Well, if you’ll settle for roughly 45 minutes, I’ve got good news for you. A new study published in Theoretical and Applied Ergonomics found that workers can squeeze 43 minutes of extra productivity out of their day, just by using a sit-stand desk. Powered By 107.1K 00ShareNextStayA team of occupational and public health researchers from Texas A&M University discovered the productivity benefits of these adjustable-height desks, which exploded in popularity around the time sitting was declared “the new smoking,” after studying more than 10,000 workers who worked at a large California energy company.
